title: UAV Scenario Lidar
source_docs: UAV Toolbox/UAV Scenario and Sensor Modeling/UAV_Scenario_Lidar.md
text: 基于场景中的网格仿真激光雷达测量；输出 1 路；{Sensor name} 指定激光雷达传感器名称、{Max range} 指定激光雷达的最大距离、{Range Accuracy} 指定激光雷达的距离精度、{Azimuthal limits} 指定激光雷达的方位角限制、{Azimuthal resolution} 指定方位角分辨率、{Elevation limits} 指定激光雷达的仰角限制、{Elevation resolution} 指定仰角分辨率、{Add noise to measurement} 指定向测量添加噪声、{Output organized point cloud locations} 输出点云位置、{Sample Time} 指定采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: Pointcloud
ports.summary: 点云数据 N -by- M -by-3 double matrix | N -by-3 double matrix

params.name: Sensor name
params.values: 激光雷达传感器名称 ’UAV/Lidar’ (default) | string

params.name: Max range
params.values: 激光雷达的最大距离 120 (default) | double

params.name: Range Accuracy
params.values: 激光雷达的距离精度 0.002 (default) | double

params.name: Azimuthal limits
params.values: 激光雷达的方位角限制 [-180, 180] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Elevation limits
params.values: 激光雷达的仰角限制 [-20, 20] (default) | two-element vector
